answer.summary: API Tests (elk8-9) failed on one deterministic assertion, TenantStatementInspectorTest.findingIndexingQueryGroupsOnEveryProjectedColumn: the generated finding-indexing SQL projects f.finding_inject_id without aggregation or GROUP BY, which the test rejects. The change touches the finding identity and recording code, so this is most likely caused by the change and will repeat on re-run. The Azure managed-identity errors and the catalog startup warning are unrelated noise.
